category_edits.rationale: Keep Adam and the baseline peak learning rate, with linear warmup over the first 5% of configured epochs followed by cosine decay to 10% of peak. This may stabilize early updates and improve late ranking refinement. Preserve architecture, loss, batch size, dropout, weight decay, seeds, evaluation, and one checkpoint per category.

change_summary: Add epoch-based 5% linear warmup and cosine learning-rate decay, enforcing the 200-epoch cap. Predictor and checkpoint formats remain compatible.
